pages.title: Pick Up Cargo
pages.text: Right-click an item on the belt to move it into your inventory. The item stays on the belt when your inventory has no room.$(br2)Cargo follows the deck through turns and slopes, and stops behind blocked items.

pages.title: Clear a Jam
pages.text: A full destination or a blocked downstream input backs up the line. Empty the destination or open space in the next section to resume transport.$(br2)Check the direction of your section and the selected faces on $(l:satiscraftory:routing/splitter)splitters$(/l) and $(l:satiscraftory:routing/merger)mergers$(/l).

pages.title: Remove a Section
pages.text: Hold left click on the belt surface to dig the entire section. A pickaxe is fastest. Cracks show your progress along the belt.$(br2)The belt item drops where you dug, and transported items drop along the route.$(br2)Players and entities can pass through belts.
